articles.text: YÓUKÈ: Āi, duìbuqǐ, lóushangde fángjiān bú gòu le.
TOURIST: Say, excuse me, there aren't enough rooms for us upstairs.
FÚWÙYUÁN: Bú gòule? Zěnme kěnéng ne? Wǒmen ānpáide hǎohāorde.
DESK CLERK: There aren't enough? How is that possible? We made all the arrangements.
YÓUKÈ: Shi zhēnde, wǒmen zhèige cānguāntuán yígòng èrshisānge rén, nǐmen gāngcái shuō wǒmen quánbù dōu zhù zài qīlóu, yígòng yǒu shísìge fángjiān, duì bu duì?
TOURIST: It's true. In all there are twenty-three people in our tour group. You just said that we're all staying on the seventh floor, in fourteen rooms altogether, right?
FÚWÙYUÁN: Duìbuqǐ, qǐng màn yìdiǎnr shuō, wǒ bú jìde le. Děngyiděng, wǒ lái kànkan! Ou, zài zhèr! Nǐmen shi yíge Měiguóde lǚxíngtuán shi bu shi?
DESK CLERK: I'm sorry, could you say that more slowly? I don't remember. Wait a minute, let me have a look. Oh, here it is. You are an American tour group, aren't you?
YÓUKÈ: Shì a!
TOURIST: That's right!
FÚWÙYUÁN: Èrshisānge rén, yígòng kāi shísìge fángjiān, quán zài qīlóu. Duì a! Méi cuò a!
DESK CLERK: Twenty-three people taking fourteen rooms altogether, all on the seventh floor. That's right! There's no mistake!
YÓUKÈ: Bú duì! Jiù yǒu shíèrge kōng fángjiān, yǒu liǎngge fángjiān hái yǒu rén na!
TOURIST: No! There are only twelve free rooms. Two of the rooms still have people in them!
FÚWÙYUÁN: Hái yǒu rén? Zěnme huì ne? Wǒ hái yǐwéi tāmen jīntian zǎochen yǐjing cóng Shēnzhèn lí jìng le ne! Zěnme dào xiànzài hái zhànzhe wūzi ne?
DESK CLERK: Still have people in them? How could that be? I thought they had left the country this morning by way of Shēnzhèn! Why are they still occupying the rooms?
YÓUKÈ: Bù zhīdào, nín zuì hǎo xiǎngxiang biéde bànfǎ, kànkan hái yǒu méiyou kōng fángzi.
TOURIST: I don't know. You'd better think of some other solution, and see if there are any other rooms free.

FÚWÙYUÁN: Biéde kōng fángzi shi yídìng méiyou a! Wǒ xiān liǎojiě yíxià zhèi liǎngge fángzi wèishénme dào xiànzài hái méiyou kōngchulai! Ou! Zhèr yǒu yíge tiáozi, shuō tāmen gǎi zài xiàwǔ sāndiǎn zhōng líkāi Běijīng. Hǎojíle! Méi wèntí le.

DESK CLERK: I'm positive there aren't any other free rooms. First let me try and find out why those two rooms haven't been vacated yet. Oh! There's a note here saying that their plans have been changed and that they're leaving Běijīng at three this afternoon. Great! No more problem.
YÓUKÈ: Xiànzài cái liǎngdiǎn zhōng, wǒmen hái děi děng duō jiǔ?
TOURIST: It's only two o'clock now, how much longer do we have to wait?
FÚWÙYUÁN: Liǎngdiǎn tāmen jiù děi líkāi fángjiān, dào fēijīchǎng děi yòng sìshifēn zhōng ne! Wǒmen gǎo yíxiàr wèishēng, sānshifēn zhōng ba!
DESK CLERK: They'll have to leave their rooms at two: it takes forty minutes to get to the airport! It will be thirty minutes while we clean the rooms.
YÓUKÈ: Nàme liǎngdiǎn bàn wǒmen jiù yǒu fángjiān le.
TOURIST: So we can have the rooms at two-thirty.
FÚWÙYUÁN: Duì le. Dào cāntīng hē bēi kāfēi, xiūxi yíxià, shíjiān jiù dào le.
DESK CLERK: Right. Why don't you go have a cup of coffee in the dining room and rest a bit, and then it will be time.
YÓUKÈ: Hǎo, xièxie nín. Huí tóu jiàn.
TOURIST: Okay. Thank you. See you later.
FÚWÙYUÁN: Huí tóu jiàn.
DESK CLERK: See you later.
